question_en: Which credit facility did Ferguson end in April 2025, and how big was it?
question_vi: Ferguson đã chấm dứt khoản vay tuần hoàn nào vào tháng 4 năm 2025 và quy mô là bao nhiêu?
reference_answer: On April 2, 2025, in connection with entering a new Revolving Credit Agreement, Ferguson terminated its existing committed $1.35 billion Multicurrency Revolving Facility Agreement; no borrowings were outstanding under it.
evidence_quotes: On April 2, 2025, in connection with the Company’s entry into the Revolving Credit Agreement, the Company terminated its existing committed $1.35 billion Multicurrency Revolving Facility Agreement originally dated March 10, 2020
No borrowings were outstanding under the Existing Revolving Facility as of the termination date.

reference_answer: No, it did not fall: Constellation Brands's stock-based compensation rose 44.2%, to $15.0 million in the three months ended May 31, 2026 from $10.4 million a year earlier.

reference_answer: For 2022, 75% of the target bonus of Messrs. Pember and Peterson was based on divisional results; for 2023, 75% of the annual salary of Messrs. Sim and Peterson was based on achieving divisional income targets, with the other 25% tied to corporate performance.
